job.job_description:
Roles and Responsibilities :

Lead the development of AI-based chatbots using cloud services like AWS, Azure, and GCP.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, develop, test, and deploy chatbot solutions for various industries.
Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior team members to ensure project delivery.
Stay updated with industry trends and best practices in chatbot development.
Ensure high-quality project delivery and meet project goals.
Work closely with team members to identify and prioritize project requirements.

Job Requirements :

Strong expertise in AIML development using cloud services such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Proven track record of successfully leading complex software development projects.
Experience with chatbot development, retrieval augmented generation, and large language models is preferred.
Excellent leadership skills are required to lead a team of engineers and provide technical guidance.
Strong communication and collaboration skills are necessary for working with cross-functional teams.
Ability to stay current with industry trends and best practices in chatbot development.
